# NNNN: Decision title

Status: Proposed

Date: YYYY-MM-DD

## Context

Describe the fictional scenario, requirement, constraints, and decision drivers. Link the relevant requirements.

## Decision

State the selected approach and its scope. Mark unresolved assumptions explicitly.

## Alternatives Considered

Describe viable alternatives and why they were not selected.

## Consequences

Describe implementation and operational implications, including relevant security, reliability, governance, and cost effects.

## Trade-offs

State what the decision improves, what it gives up, and when it should be revisited. Identify how the decision will be validated.
